purpose: Technical handover for faithfully recreating the existing ITCS design. Reuse the original implementation wherever available. Do not reinterpret this as a new visual direction.

accuracy.not_recoverable_from_this_json: Exact binary assets, the full character rig, recorded audio, original font files and every source-code detail.

deployment.new_repository: Replace the old deployment base with the new application's actual base.

Use the same ITCS logo asset.

paper_feed_animation.cleanup: Cancel animations and timers and remove component event listeners.

responsive_rules.380px_and_below: Receipt becomes one column; actions stack; decorative utility text becomes smaller.
